bullets.text: AI-Powered Innovations Unveiled - **Microsoft** showcases groundbreaking AI PCs and collaborations at CES 2026, enhancing user experiences.
Navigating AI-Driven Careers - **Microsoft** and **LinkedIn** launch 'Open to Work', a guide for adapting to AI's impact on jobs.
Privacy Meets Security - **Microsoft** emphasizes the integration of privacy and security as complementary priorities in its services.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Released - New features and improvements rolled out in the latest Windows 11 Insider Preview build.
Xbox Developer_Direct Returns - Celebrate Xbox’s 25th anniversary with insights into upcoming games on January 22.
Enhancing Cyber Resilience - **Microsoft** introduces proactive incident response services to help organizations strengthen cybersecurity.
